forms.description: Entity worklist: dataContext(v8) + datatable, toolbar with Add (Show Dialog modal), quick search, pager, row navigate action column.
Single-record detail: header band, Start Edit/Submit/Cancel lifecycle buttonGroup, labelled field sections.
Main+rail hub (962/332 split): flex containers sized via desktop.dimensions.width, KIB-style meta strip, tabs, related panels. Largest fixture — grep only.
Create/edit page: input fields, validationErrors, Save(Submit/shesha.form primary) + Back buttonGroup.
Minimal standalone create form (smallest capture exemplar — the floor shape: fields + validationErrors + Save/Back).
Create dialog opened via Show Dialog: editable fields, preset-FK pattern (component + onPrepareSubmitData), dialog-close wiring.
Card list: dataContext + datalist (formSelectionMode name) pointing at the item card form.
The datalist row-template card (bound text, fit-content dimensions, ellipsis, status chip row) [R-048].
Inline-editable datatable: crud-operations column, editComponent {type,settings} shapes, canEditInline flags [R-010].
Entity-bound landing/dashboard: stat containers + chart placeholders + shortcut links.

Anonymous full-page form (access:5): login/register/OTP shell — branded page chrome, input fields, Submit wired to an app-service endpoint [R-041], no entity CRUD. Manual-clone archetype (the compiler does not wire anonymous auth).
